content:
nina (AE): starting POC thread for Oliver Retail. They're testing streaming SDK + toolcalls + enforced structured output. Key asks: EU data residency, short-lived creds, CIDR allowlist, and a clear pricing delta for reserved vs hosted.

oliver_retail: hi team — we need a working demo with streaming toolcalls to an internal enrichment webhook (EU), and schema enforcement so our downstream pipeline gets parsable JSON. Traffic: baseline ~120 qps, peaks ~700 qps. We also need a simple guide to roll from hosted -> dedicated.

sam (SE): thanks. short answers: streaming toolcalls supported; schema enforcement available via `schema_enforce` flags. rolling from hosted to dedicated is a config + model pinning step. will paste minimal snippets.

viv (DevEx): node sample (very small):

```js
// stream + toolcall (pseudo)
const c = new RedwoodClient(process.env.RW_KEY)
const s = c.chat.stream({model: 'redwood-2x', schema_enforce: 'strict'})
s.send({role: 'user', content: 'Return orders as JSON array'})
for await (const ev of s) {
  if (ev.type === 'tool_call') {
    // call internal webhook
    const res = await fetch('https://enrich.internal.eu/api', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(ev.args)})
    const body = await res.json()
    s.sendToolResult(ev.tool, body)
  }
  if (ev.type === 'chunk') process.stdout.write(ev.chunk)
}
```

viv (DevEx): note: set `tool_timeout_ms` higher if webhook does enrichment (default 4000). Also implement exponential backoff for transient 5xx.

ken (Security): checklist for POC access:
- Signed EU data residency addendum
- CIDR allowlist for both our egress (to their webhook) and their ingress to hosted endpoints
- If they want short-lived creds: we support token service for temporary keys; for Private/Dedicated mTLS or customer-managed KMS available
- Need point-of-contact to complete security questionnaire

oliver_retail: webhook CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24. They use bearer tokens for webhook auth. Security contact: karen@oliverretail.com.

sam (SE): capacity recommendation: for sustained 120 qps and 700 spikes, start hosted with autoscale and move to reserved pool sized for 250 qps sustained to give headroom. Example autoscale values attached in gist (I'll DM).

viv (DevEx): pricing note: streaming doesn't alter per-token rates; however, reserved pools have a fixed monthly cost plus lower effective per-token compute. i'll run a quick sim and post numbers.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled -> region: eu-west-1 | window: 2025-02-15T07:00Z | monitor: p95 latency, toolcall error-rate

nina (AE): action items:
1) ken: send security questionnaire to karen@oliverretail.com (ETA: EOD)
2) viv: simulation comparing hosted vs reserved cost for their profile (ETA: 48h)
3) sam: brief autoscale + migration playbook (ETA: tomorrow)
4) viv/sam: upload node/go/python minimal samples to the drive and share link (ETA: tomorrow)

oliver_retail: pairing session would be great — 14:00 CET tomorrow. We'll provide test webhook and creds.

viv (DevEx): happy to pair. tip: enable `schema_enforce: 'strict'` in POC so we catch mismatches early. If you see validation errors, runtime returns `structured_validation_error` with the field path.

sam (SE): also, for partner webhooks behind bearer tokens, ensure token rotation is handled by the client; we support forwarding ephemeral creds if using Private.

oliver_retail: acknowledged. we'll send webhook creds and security contact. thanks all :thumbsup:

nina (AE): closing notes here; will re-open if any blocker arises.
